question: Can a physical choke supply approximately 258.215 uH effective at operating bias, carrying the supplied envelope, without erasing the 11.82 W switching saving?

envelope.note: Same envelope at every frequency because L*f is held constant; only inductance changes.

frequency_trade.decision_rule: A candidate choke wins only if its increase in DC+AC+core loss over the retained Wurth 760800301 at this envelope is less than the switching saving.

focus: Up to three exact catalog or custom-vendor candidates near 258.2 uH effective at the supplied bias and 90 kHz. Capture L versus DC bias/temperature, tolerance, the saturation definition and the current at which it is specified, thermal current rating, DCR, core and winding loss applicability at this ripple and frequency, dimensions, mass and a dated price/availability observation. Evaluate the supplied envelope keeping RMS heating and peak saturation SEPARATE: the choke must not saturate at 23.27 A peak, and must not overheat at 15.0 A rms with 4.20 A pk-pk ripple. ALSO capture the retained baseline Wurth 760800301's own DC+AC+core loss at the same envelope, so the coordinator can compute the magnetic loss DELTA. If no complete catalog option exists, provide a vendor/custom winding requirement with the unknowns stated; do not design a core from invented material data.
